about: Locked out of a my Social Security account: Login.gov and ID.me.

rows.plain: Social Security's online services use Login.gov or ID.me. You only need one of them.
If Login.gov locked you during identity checks (too many tries on your ID, personal information or phone), you must wait six hours before trying again.

Login.gov can check your identity in person at a participating Post Office. Start online first and choose the Post Office option; bring the barcode it emails you and your state-issued ID or driver's license.
With ID.me, if you do not have a personal phone or use a shared device, you can verify on a video call.
ID.me also offers in-person checks at participating UPS Store locations.
You do not need a mobile phone: you can use a security key, a landline or backup codes for the second step.
You can also verify your identity at a local Social Security office. Bring your driver's license, state ID or passport.
Most things you would do online, you can also do by calling Social Security at 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778).
